Drum Machine

A 16-step drum machine with synthesized kick, snare, hat and clap plus BPM control.

All sounds are synthesized live with Web Audio — no samples, no downloads. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Toggle steps on the 16-step grid.
  2. Set the BPM with the tempo slider.
  3. Press Play to hear your beat.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are the drum sounds real samples?

All sounds are synthesized live with Web Audio oscillators and filtered noise — no samples or downloads.

How do I program a beat?

Click steps to toggle them; the four rows are kick, snare, hi-hat and clap.

What tempo range is available?

From 60 to 200 BPM with the tempo slider.
